routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's labels (and title/content/color/reminder); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
archive or unarchive a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin or unpin a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
permanently delete a note from the Trash view; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
empty the trash; returns 200 with the removed count

notes: REQ-2.7.6.3 (View Reminders) reuses the sidebar label filter built for REQ-2.7.6.1 on top of the REQ-2.7.1 label assignment and the REQ-2.7.3 default label. The sidebar (opened via the 'Main menu' button) renders each catalog label as a .label-filter-item button with an exact accessible name; 'Reminders' (the default label, seeded in LABEL_CATALOG = ['Work','Reminders','Work editable']) carries a bell icon with aria-hidden so its accessible name is exactly 'Reminders' — the name the acceptance test clicks via getByRole('button', {name: 'Reminders'}). Clicking it sets state.labelFilter = 'Reminders' and re-renders, so visibleInView() shows only notes whose labels array includes 'Reminders': the seeded regular note 'Call dentist existing' (labels ['Reminders']) is shown, while 'Movie list' (labels [], no 'Work'/'Reminders' label) is filtered out. The filter is pure per-page-load client state, so parallel test files sharing one backend never observe each other's filters. Fixtures 'Call dentist existing' (labels ['Reminders']) and 'Movie list' (labels []) are already seeded in backend/data/db.json (REQ-2.7.3/REQ-2.7.6.1). No backend or route changes required.
